overview: A depressed man moves back in with his parents following a recent heartbreak.

recs.blurb: Adam, a lonely man with Asperger's Syndrome, develops a relationship with his upstairs neighbor, Beth.
As he copes with the death of his fiancee along with her parents, a young man must figure out what he wants out of life.
After spending eight months in a mental institution, a former teacher moves back in with his parents and tries to reconcile with his ex-wife.
A woman risks losing her chance of happiness with the only man she has ever loved.
An emotionally-beaten man with his young daughter moves to his ancestral home in Newfoundland to reclaim his life.
Failing to make it on his own, 27-year-old Jim moves back in with his parents and deals with crippling family obligations.
A man crippled by the mundanity of his life experiences something out of the ordinary.
We follow 24 hours in the life of a being moving from life to life like a cold and solitary assassin moving from hit to hit. In each of these interwoven lives…
In the small town of Mumford, a psychologist of the same name moves in and quickly becomes very popular, despite a questionable past.
A holiday fable that tells the story of an elderly man discovering love for the first time.
A self-centered realtor enlists the help of his neighbor when he's suddenly left in charge of the granddaughter he never knew existed until his estranged son…
Verona and Burt have moved to Colorado to be close to Burt's parents but, with Veronica expecting their first child, Burt’s parents decide to move to Belgium…
